description: Most failing ad accounts don't have a creative problem, they have an offer problem. Fix this first.
transcript: We've tried loads of different ads. None of them are working. Meta just doesn't work for our business. Before we brief creative, we audit the offer. Is the price competitive? Is the risk reversal strong enough? Is the value proposition clear enough? In under 5 seconds? Weak creative can hide a strong offer. Strong creative can't save a weak offer. Most failing ad accounts aren't failing because of the ads. They're failing because the offer isn't good enough. Great offer almost advertises itself. The ad just needs to communicate it clearly. When we look at a new ad account, we look at the offer before we look at account structure. What's the guarantee? What's the friction to purchase? Is there a compelling reason to buy today rather than later? A 20% discount is not a great offer. A great offer is a complete value exchange that makes the decision feel like a no brainer. We've seen accounts more than double revenue not by changing a single ad, but by restructuring the offer, adding a bonus, tightening a guarantee, creating urgency that's real rather than manufactured. Fix the offer first.
